_comment: Seed manifest for the privatebin held-out suite target (plan-005 U1, R1). PrivateBin is the encrypted-paste archetype. Pastes are created client-side encrypted; live seeding is docker-required (the generic SuiteTargetEnv drives the paste API headlessly). The frozen suite slice's hand-verified verdicts are defined against THIS post-seed state. Offline the manifest is shape-validated only.
